#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    long long capacity, flow;
    long long cost;
};

struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<long long> dist;
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<bool> in_queue;
    int source, sink;
    long long total_flow, total_cost;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) : n(n), source(s), sink(t) {
        adj.resize(n);
        dist.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        in_queue.resize(n);
        total_flow = total_cost = 0;
    }

    void add_edge(int u, int v, long long cap, long long cst) {
        edges.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cst});
        edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cst});
        adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool spfa() {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(in_queue.begin(), in_queue.end(), false);
        dist[source] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        in_queue[source] = true;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            in_queue[u] = false;
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                Edge &e = edges[id];
                if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.to] = id;
                    if (!in_queue[e.to]) {
                        q.push(e.to);
                        in_queue[e.to] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != LLONG_MAX;
    }

    pair<long long, long long> min_cost_max_flow() {
        while (spfa()) {
            long long push = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = edges[parent[v]].from) {
                push = min(push, edges[parent[v]].capacity - edges[parent[v]].flow);
            }
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = edges[parent[v]].from) {
                edges[parent[v]].flow += push;
                edges[parent[v] ^ 1].flow -= push;
            }
            total_flow += push;
            total_cost += push * dist[sink];
        }
        return {total_flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int t = k * (n - 1);
    int total_nodes = t * n + 2;
    int source = t * n;
    int sink = t * n + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow g(total_nodes, source, sink);
    for (int i = 0; i < t; ++i) {
        g.add_edge(i * n, sink, 100, c * i);
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (i + 1 < t)
                g.add_edge(i * n + j, (i + 1) * n + j, 100, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        int x; cin >> x;
        g.add_edge(source, x - 1, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v; cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int j = 0; j < t - 1; ++j) {
            int v1 = j * n + u;
            int v2 = (j + 1) * n + v;

                g.add_edge(v1, v2, 1, cost_val);

            for (int q = 0; q < k; ++q) {
                long long cost_val = (q == 0) ? d : (q == 1) ? 4 * d : d * (2 * q + 1);
                g.add_edge(v1, v2, 1, cost_val);
            }
        }
    }
    auto result = g.min_cost_max_flow();
